content:
sam: Quick thread  launch week microexperiment idea: gated vs instant credits + prompt-template followup. Keep it simple.

rhea: Love it. Hypotheses: gated lowers churn but may increase initial friction; instant boosts immediate try rate. We'll test conversion to first successful request at 24h and 7d.

alec: Suggested splits: control=no-credit, A=instant 1000 on signup, B=gated 300 on confirm + 1000 on first request. Track variant in user traits.

mika: Can we also tie prompt template exposure? Variant A gets an onboarding email with 3 curated prompt templates; B gets the templates only after first request. Measure prompts_used metric.

sam: Good call. Also want a short benchmark clip (30s) showing cost/latency delta with caching on. Use a product GIF in the post.

alec: Pseudocode for Segment -> webhook:
```
if (traits.is_new_account && !traits.opt_out) {
  webhook.post('/hooks/credit-grant', {user_id: id, variant: traits.launch_variant})
}
```

mika: ops-bot can you spin up the staging hooks and give a test id?

ops-bot: Staging hooks deployed: /hooks/credit-grant-v2 and /hooks/promptpack-deliver. Test run: hook_run_9012. Logs: https://ops.internal/tests/hook_run_9012 :white_check_mark: 

rhea: Need analytics events: launch_variant, launch_credit_granted, promptpack_sent, first_request. Alec can you add idempotency for hooks so we don't double-credit?

alec: Will add idempotency token and TTL. Also will include utm_variant param on landing page links.

sam: Action items: alec -> webhook idempotency + Segment rules; mika -> email copy variants + promptpack; rhea -> tracking dashboard (24h/7d windows); ops-bot -> confirm hook logs. Quick check-in tomorrow 9:30am PT. :rocket:
